title: could we all be having similar dreams because we’re on similar medications?

classification.theory_summary: Asks whether similar Mall World dreams could be related to similar medications (mentions SSRIs/psychotropic meds and dream side effects).
classification.question_topic: Whether Mall World-like shared dream experiences correlate with taking SSRIs/other psychotropic medications; asks what meds others are on.
classification.skip_reason: No dream narrative or phenomenological description of a specific dream; post is a research/survey question about medication effects.

meta.author_theory: Mentions a theory raised by boyfriend: similar dream spaces might be caused by medications such as SSRIs; notes psychotropic meds can cause intense dreams/nightmares and SSRIs can reduce dream recall.
